purpose: Atomic and idempotent self-scoped creation of one LR-12 product profile and immutable operation receipt.

routine.return_type: TABLE(life_area_ref uuid, name text, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: No Domain MaterialStateRef is introduced for initial profile create/read.
state_history.current_binding: Self-scoped current profile row; no accepted item assignment yet.
state_history.chronology: created_at is statement-time PostgreSQL truth, not UUIDv7 order.
state_history.immutability_policy: Creation receipts immutable; mutation/history design remains B05-A2.

lifecycle.retention: Retained for later association and user organization.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; downgrade refuses while any Life Area or receipt exists.

obligations: Runtime has no raw table DML or SELECT; operations use self-scoped guarded routines.
A profile ID is not NativeRef, ScopedRecordRef or Domain ownership.
Function owner dante_owner, trusted search_path and least-privilege runtime EXECUTE.
Concurrent same key serializes; same intent replays; differing intent conflicts.
